nome: DICA 2 · Deploy, Train, and Follow Up

lado_card.texto: This course picks up where DICA 1 ends: with the opportunity map for Clínica Vila Serena (fictional) and one chosen recommendation.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · eventos.inema.pro/consultoria-ia · Professional 2030 · inema.club

inicio.titulo: Deploy, train, and follow up: from the map to an assistant that runs on its own
inicio.lead: The diagnosis is done and the owner has picked where to start. Now you choose the first assistant, write its playbook, turn it on with approval in phases, teach the owner and the team, and follow up until it runs on its own. All of it at Clínica Vila Serena, a fictional clinic with 9 people and a reception desk on WhatsApp.
inicio.capa_alt: Reception desk of a small clinic at dusk, with an open notebook and a phone on the counter.
inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of a delivery: choose, write the playbook, turn it on in phases, decide how to build, teach, follow up, maintain, and close out the dossier.

itens: Small business owners (clinic, real estate agency, bakery, repair shop, store) who want to bring AI into their own business with a method, without an IT team and without scares.
Beginner consultants who serve small businesses and already know how to sell the diagnosis: here you learn to deliver.
Anyone who took DICA 1 · Diagnosis and came out with an opportunity map.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Choose the first assistant using the 3 criteria and write what it does not do.
Write the playbook in 7 parts and turn the assistant on in 3 approval phases.
Train the owner and the internal champion in 90 minutes and leave behind a 1-page manual.
Follow up with a 20-minute check-in, 5 indicators, and 3 alerts, until the cadence becomes monthly.
Professional 2030 has four roles that sell trust, not construction. The DICA Program is the Consultant role, focused on small businesses.
Building is part of the service; what lasts is the diagnosis, the teaching, and the follow-up.
Pricing, proposal, and selling the follow-up: Selling with AI 4 and Selling with AI 5.
The agent's authority limits and progressive trust: AI Management · Agents.
Test before turning on: Professional 2030 · Mentor. Measure 30/60/90: Professional 2030 · Consultant.
LGPD (Brazil's data protection law) in depth: Professional 2030 · Auditor.
